rule: D-15 restart rebuild; 16-DEC-O-07 page cap (ratify current)
summary: The SHADOW restore replays 1m minutes from the earliest filled position of each symbol (closed ones included); the poller refuses more than 20 pages of 1500, so every start fails once that position is older than 20.83 days.
expected: A restart at any age of the trial rebuilds the ledger and continues.
actual: shadow.start raises LiveMinutePollError -> RuntimeFailClosed -> exit 7 at every start; the same budget fails the loop in-run when a symbol's last stored minute is older than 20.83 days.
impact: The 14-day trial is unaffected; the planned 3-6 month paper observation cannot be restarted after about day 21 from the first fill without a code change (a new image).
evidence: shadow_runtime.py:1070-1079 (since = min eligibility over ALL SHADOW_POSITION_OPENED records); shadow_ledger.py:1022-1029 (load_records: every approved approval); live_minutes.py:51-52, 320-335 (_MAX_PAGES = 20, raise). Probe output: '20 days: OK added 28799'; '21 days: LiveMinutePollError: trade minutes of BTCUSDT are more than 20 pages behind'.
why_tests_miss: The page cap is tested as a guard; no test restores a ledger whose first position is older than the cap.
recommendation: Bound the replay (ledger checkpoints, or book closed positions from their journaled trade record), trim LiveMinuteSource, size the page budget from the requested span.
known_prior: KNOWN:16-REVIEW-batch1 IN-07 (weight and 'never trimmed' only, Info); this consequence is not recorded

rule: one ledger per paper epoch (shadow_ledger.py:156); REV-18 new pin = new trial
summary: The ledger restore reads every approved SHADOW approval of the database, not those of the pinned epoch, so a new epoch on the same database replays the earlier epoch's positions.
expected: A new epoch starts from the configured initial equity with no position of an earlier epoch.
actual: A booking dated before the new epoch's first UTC day raises 'cannot roll the ledger backwards' inside the rebuild (start fails, exit 7); a booking of the same UTC day is added to the new epoch's equity and day PnL.
impact: The documented route for a changed configuration value or a failed trial is a new pin; on the same soak database that epoch cannot start or starts with foreign PnL (example: 618 instead of 600 equity and one inherited open position).
evidence: shadow_ledger.py:1022-1029; persistence/shadow_stores.py:193-221 (mode filter only); shadow_ledger.py:1196-1199 (apply every booking); backtest/ledger.py:144-148; shadow_runtime.py:1389-1393 (ledger starts at epoch.opened_at_utc).
reproduction: Not run. Trace: runtime.py:1121 -> shadow_runtime.py:986, 1063, 1094-1101 -> shadow_ledger.py:1139-1141, 1196-1199 -> backtest/ledger.py:144.
why_tests_miss: Restore tests use one epoch per store.
recommendation: Scope load_records to the epoch; state in the RUNBOOK whether a new pin needs an empty database.

summary: Health is proven only by the first live closed 1h bar after a start, so every start or restart more than 15 minutes before an hour close produces an uncovered block above the 900 s ceiling and fails the trial.
expected: The ceiling measures real outages; a 60 s restart is a 60 s outage.
actual: Probe: start at 10:00:30 -> longest uncovered 3600.299 s, ceiling_pass False; a 60 s planned restart at 12:20 -> 2400.299 s, False; the same restart at 12:50 -> True.
impact: The trial verdict depends on the minute of the hour of each start; a crash restart cannot be timed, so most restarts cost a new pin and 14 more days. A false FAIL (safe side), but it invites loosening the number without a derivation.
evidence: runtime.py:1071-1077 (DISCONNECTED at start), 852-858 (HEALTHY at the first live closed event); coverage.py:650 (run.start -> first message uncovered), 319 (ceiling_pass); 16-DEC-O-07.md line 7 (silence moved 15 -> 3900 for the hourly cadence, ceiling left at 900); RUNBOOK line 709 names only pin-to-start time.
reproduction: tmp/paper_runtime/cov_probe.py scenarios A, B, D, E
why_tests_miss: Coverage tests place HEALTHY evidence at chosen instants; none derives the ceiling from a real start sequence.
recommendation: Owner decision: journal feed proof within seconds of a start, or set the ceiling from the evidence cadence, or exempt the start window explicitly.

rule: each expected close has exactly one record or one explained gap (restart.py:160-162)
summary: A close between the pin and a pair's first processed bar gets neither a processed nor a gap record, so the criterion 'no missing journal row' fails.
expected: Such a close has a gap record with a reason.
actual: downtime_gaps skips a pair with no processed bar; probe scenario C (pin 10:58:00, start 11:00:30) leaves 5 rows without a record.
impact: A trial pinned minutes before an hour close, or one that crashes in its first hours, fails a criterion for a reason the records do not explain.
evidence: restart.py:172-174 ('if last is None: continue'); exit_criteria.py:748-772; probe output 'rows without record=5' and 'downtime_gaps with no processed bar yet: ()'.
why_tests_miss: Restart tests start from a restored last close.
recommendation: Use the pin instant as the baseline when a pair has no processed bar.

summary: The pin and every RUNTIME_START name the parameter set and the configuration identity but no code build, so the trial evidence can come from more than one image and the bundle cannot show it.
expected: The evidence bundle shows which build produced each run of the trial.
actual: No build field exists in any src/paper record or in the evaluator/exporter scripts; TRADING_APP_REVISION is read only by src/live/runtime.py. Parity replays recorded inputs with the evaluator's code and so notices only a change of decision code.
impact: A restart with another IMAGE_TAG is invisible in the records; changes to the supervisor, pipeline gates, fill driver, ledger or cost code between builds are not detected by any criterion.
evidence: freeze.py:373-395 (epoch id fields); runtime.py:551-567, 1696-1713 (RUNTIME_START payload); runtime_config.py:70-86 (allowed env names); src/adapters/code_version.py:36; search for IMAGE_COMMIT|code_version|commit|revision|image over src/paper, scripts/evaluate_trial_soak.py, scripts/export_soak_evidence.py: no build field.
why_tests_miss: No test asserts a build field on RUNTIME_START or EPOCH_PINNED.
recommendation: Record the build stamp on EPOCH_PINNED and every RUNTIME_START; add a 'one build per trial' criterion or list the builds.

component: risk inputs at the bar close
summary: A bar is evaluated with the SHADOW ledger as last booked by the minute poller, which lags the bar close by at least the 5 s close lag, so an exit in the last minute of the hour is not yet booked.
expected: The ledger at the bar close equals what the backtest engine reads after advancing to that close.
actual: An SL/TP exit in the final minute is still an open position and its PnL is missing from equity and the daily loss when the bar's signal is sized and gated.
impact: In about 1 of 60 exits (if uniform) paper can take or refuse a different trade or size than the backtest of the same data; the parity criterion cannot see it.
evidence: market_inputs.py:193-196 (documented claim), 198-210; shadow_ledger.py:410-435 ('the stored ledger moves only through bookings'); shadow_runtime.py:831-850; live_minutes.py:273 (horizon = now - close_lag).
reproduction: Not run; follows from minute_close_lag_seconds = 5 and minute_poll_interval_seconds = 2.
why_tests_miss: The tracer test compares one plan's record, not ledger timing around a bar close.
recommendation: Wait for the settled watermark to reach the bar close before evaluating, or document the difference and count affected bars.

rule: Q-D history-only applies to bars not received live
summary: A live closed bar held during a recovery is dropped as a duplicate when the backfill of the same recovery also returns that close, so a bar that was received live is never evaluated.
expected: A bar received live is evaluated.
actual: The REST copy advances the cursor first; the held live copy is logged as duplicate_close_dropped and the pipeline records a PAPER_GAP.
impact: A missed evaluation recorded as a gap (fail closed); a few seconds of exposure per recovery, including the start seam and the SDK's daily rotation.
evidence: supervisor.py:337-341 (hold), 610-614 (backfill advances the cursor), 372-379 and 349-356 (flush -> duplicate), 546-550 (only gaps are reconciled with held bars).
why_tests_miss: Seam tests use a backfill that does not return the held close.
recommendation: Drop from the backfill result any close that is in the held list.

rule: D-35 clock skew logged, no threshold
summary: REST rows are judged closed by the host clock and the skew has no bound: a host ahead stores a forming row as history, a host behind drops every live closed bar.
expected: A REST row counts as closed only when the exchange closed it; a start with a large skew is refused.
actual: Host ahead: the later live copy conflicts and the loop exits 7 (self-heals on restart). Host behind: FUTURE_CLOSE drops and a 200-bar evaluation lockout (known).
impact: A restart, or a silent no-evaluation period visible only as an unhealthy probe after 3900 s.
evidence: resync.py:300; restart.py:292-294; market_inputs.py:216-226 ('logged, no threshold'); pipeline.py:304-313, 354-355.
why_tests_miss: Tests inject one clock for both the exchange and the host.
recommendation: Refuse the start above a skew bound, re-measure periodically, decide closed-ness from the next row or the server time.
known_prior: KNOWN:16-REVIEW-batch1 IN-01 covers the host-behind side only (deferred, Info)
